components.name: Light Primary Button
components.description: Start/Stop action. Native minimum height and content growth are preserved; opacity changes on press or when unconfigured. Browser focus outline is a preview adapter.
components.css: .ds-light-surface { background: #F4F8F5; color: #142D28; padding: 24px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-light-primary { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 56px; margin-top: 12px; padding: 16px 24px; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #006B55; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 16px/24px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-light-primary:hover { background: #006B55; } .ds-light-primary:focus-visible { outline: auto; } .ds-light-primary:active { opacity: 0.75; } .ds-light-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; }

components.name: Light Text Button
components.description: Plain permission or connection action. No custom native pressed or hover treatment; browser focus outline is a preview adapter.
components.css: .ds-light-surface { background: #F4F8F5; color: #142D28; padding: 24px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-light-text { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 0; display: flex; align-items: center; text-align: left; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #006B55; font: 600 16px/24px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-light-text:hover { background: transparent; } .ds-light-text:focus-visible { outline: auto; }

components.name: Light Input Field
components.description: Labeled connection field. Native vertical metrics are platform-owned; the preview retains browser defaults. Pairing uses the same styling with masked entry.

narrative.overview:
This is the implemented utility direction from PRODUCT.md, not a final product identity. A flat green surface, plain system text, and a single filled action keep the interface direct. Status and controls carry the visual hierarchy; decoration does not.

The source of truth is `mobile/App.tsx`. The light, dark, and enlarged-text Pixel captures in `.impeccable/review/` support the visual review disposition of SHIP. They establish the rendered idle interface, not acceptance of live voice, correction timing, or speaker echo cancellation.
keyCharacteristics: One scrolling column with native safe areas and scalable text.
Coordinated light and dark semantic roles.
Filled primary action, plain text actions, and tonal input fields.
Minimal copy, no decorative cards or pills, and no continuous animation.

rules.name: The Paired Roles Rule
rules.body: Switch the complete scheme with the device appearance; retain the matching on-primary text when changing the action fill.

rules.name: The Native Scaling Rule
rules.body: Let text wrap and the page scroll as the system text setting grows; the build does not truncate these roles or impose fixed text containers.

rules.name: The Flat Utility Rule
rules.body: Separate content with spacing and text hierarchy; preserve the confirmed absence of decorative cards, pills, and section rules.

dos: Do use the complete light or dark role set, including its on-primary text.
Do preserve native text scaling, wrapping, scrolling, and safe-area padding.
Do retain minimum touch heights while allowing content to grow.
Do show status and recoverable errors as readable text.
donts: Don't add decorative cards, pills, or section rules.
Don't turn this utility direction into a final brand or audience commitment.
Don't treat idle screenshots as proof of live voice acceptance.
